# Reference template

## Structure (Diátaxis reference)

- Tables over prose
- Invariants (must / must not)
- Links to runtime API (`getModuleCatalog`) not duplicated lists
- Code identifiers unchanged between EN and RU

Example: [INTEGRATOR_SCOPE.md](../INTEGRATOR_SCOPE.md), [AI_ERROR_ACTION_MATRIX.md](../AI_ERROR_ACTION_MATRIX.md).
